content.text: Eid al-Fitr 2026: As Ramadan draws to a close, millions across the world are searching for answers to when is eid 2026, last day of ramadan 2026 and when does ramadan end 2026. The festival of Eid al-Fitr 2026, marking the end of a month-long fast, is expected to be celebrated around March 20, subject to the sighting of the crescent moon.The exact Eid date and Eid time will depend on the visibility of the Shawwal moon on the evening of March 19, a tradition followed by Muslim communities globally.When is Eid al-Fitr 2026?Astronomical calculations suggest that Eid al-Fitr 2026 is likely to fall on Friday, March 20. However, as per Islamic tradition, the festival begins only after the crescent moon is sighted.If the moon is visible on March 19 evening, Eid will be celebrated the next day. Otherwise, Ramadan will complete 30 days, making March 20 the confirmed day of celebration.Many communities look to official announcements from Saudi Arabia and local moon-sighting committees before confirming the Eid date.When Does Ramadan End in 2026?The last day of Ramadan 2026 is expected to be March 19, depending on the lunar cycle. The conclusion of Ramadan marks the beginning of Shawwal, the 10th month of the Islamic calendar.Ramadan is considered the holiest month in Islam, involving fasting from dawn to sunset, increased prayer, charity and reflection. The end of this period brings joy and gratitude, celebrated through Eid Mubarak greetings and gatherings. Getty ImagesEid Mubarak wishes to share with your loved ones What is Eid al-Fitr and why is it celebrated?Eid al-Fitr 2026, often called the “Festival of Breaking the Fast,” signifies spiritual renewal after a month of discipline and devotion.The day begins with special prayers at mosques, followed by festive meals, charity (Zakat al-Fitr), and social visits. Families wear new clothes, exchange gifts and share sweets.The word “Eid” means festival, while “Fitr” refers to breaking the fast, together symbolising celebration after restraint.
